players.product: Liquid cooling, power distribution units, enclosures and electrical connection/protection for AI data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Backlog was $2.3 billion as of December 31, 2025 (remaining performance obligations $2,349.9 million); the increase from 2024 was primarily the result of the Electrical Products Group acquisition and the growth of nVent's data centers business. A growing portion of backlog, particularly in the infrastructure vertical, has a longer design and manufacturing process that can take more than one year; nVent expects the majority of year-end 2025 backlog to ship in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $2.3 billion; RPO $2,349.9 million (as of December 31, 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditures in 2025 were $93.3 million consolidated versus $74.0 million in 2024, with the Systems Protection segment at $66.8 million versus $45.9 million; contractual purchase obligations for raw materials were $69.8 million for 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: capex $93.3 million (2025) vs $74.0 million; Systems Protection $66.8 million vs $45.9 million; purchase obligations $69.8 million (2026)
